import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "585fbf9340de57a9bc6fcd662e5979bb37a9c7c9"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch}")

runtime = wt/"src/do_again/browser/runtime.py"
text = runtime.read_text()
old = '''def _conversation_pressure_chars(target: cdp.Target) -> int:
    expression = "(() => {" + _MESSAGE_NODES_JS + r"""
const nodes = messageNodes();
return nodes.reduce((sum, el) => sum + String(el.innerText || el.textContent || '').length, 0);
})()"""
    value = cdp.evaluate(target, expression, timeout=10.0)
    try:
        return max(0, int(value or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0
'''
new = '''def _conversation_pressure_chars(target: cdp.Target) -> int:
    expression = "(() => {" + _MESSAGE_NODES_JS + r"""
const nodes = messageNodes();
return nodes.reduce((sum, el) => sum + String(el.innerText || el.textContent || '').length, 0);
})()"""
    try:
        value = cdp.evaluate(target, expression, timeout=10.0)
    except Exception:
        # Proactive rollover is best-effort. A transient metrics read must not
        # block receipt delivery; the context-limit warning remains the hard fallback.
        return 0
    try:
        return max(0, int(value or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("pressure helper pattern not found")
runtime.write_text(text.replace(old,new,1))

test = wt/"tests/test_browser.py"
t = test.read_text()
if 'patch("do_again.browser.runtime.secrets.token_hex", return_value="fixedtoken"),' not in t:
    anchor = '''                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime.cdp.create_target", return_value=new_target),
'''
    if anchor not in t:
        raise SystemExit("legacy rollover test anchor missing")
    t = t.replace(anchor, anchor + '''                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime.secrets.token_hex", return_value="fixedtoken"),
''', 1)
t = t.replace(
'''                            "response": "DO_AGAIN_PROJECT_READY",
''',
'''                            "response": "DO_AGAIN_HANDOFF_READY fixedtoken",
''',
1)
test.write_text(t)

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_browser.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"], env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")

focused=run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_browser_hardening","tests.test_browser"], check=False, env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_browser.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"])
commit=run(["git","commit","-m","Add transactional chat rollover foundation"], check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)
print("new_head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
